title: NR NTN Enhancements / Cell reselection / TN Measurements Skipping for NR Cell
conformance_requirements:
References: The conformance requirements covered in the present TC are specified in: TS 38.304 clauses 5.2.4.2,
5.2.4.7.0 and TS 38.331 clauses 5.2.2.4.27, 6.3.1. Unless otherwise stated these are Rel-18 requirements.
[TS 38.304, clause 5.2.4.2]
Following rules are used by the UE to limit needed measurements:
...
     - For UE camping on NTN cell, if the UE supports skipping TN measurement, and the UE has obtained its
         location information, and if coverageAreaInfoList and tn-AreaIdList are broadcast in system information, the UE
         may not perform measurements of a TN frequency when UE is not in the coverage of that frequency provided
         via tn-AreaIdList, regardless of the frequency priority.
[TS 38.304, clause 5.2.4.7.0]
coverageAreaInfoList
This indicates a list of TN coverage areas to assist skipping TN measurements for NTN UEs in RRC_IDLE and
RRC_INACTIVE states.
...
tn-AreaIdList
This indicates a list of TN area identities associated with each frequency to assist skipping TN measurements for NTN
UEs in RRC_IDLE and RRC_INACTIVE states. Each TN area identity in the list identifies a TN coverage area.
[TS 38.331, clause 5.2.2.4.27]
No UE requirements related to the contents of SIB25 apply other than those specified elsewhere e.g. within procedures
                                                             SIB25 field descriptions
